_doc: Topic selection v3. Categories come from the channel descriptions (AI tools, repos, news). Templates are never used to choose a topic. Weights sum to 1.0.

tool.description: a usable AI product, model, API or offer you can try this week

news.description: an AI launch, change, deadline or paid-to-free offer with a dated source

repo.description: an open-source AI repository with a licence and real setup needs
